title: A School-Based Osteoporosis Prevention Program for Adolescent Girls
brief_summary: The Incorporating More Physical Activity and Calcium in Teens (IMPACT) study was a behaviorally-based middle school nutrition and physical activity program for the prevention of osteoporosis. The goal of IMPACT was to increase calcium intake and physical activity to help build bone mass in girls.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Girls enrolled in 6th grade of selected schools
* Student assent
* Parental consent
* No fractures or medications that compromise bone health or strength
* Enrolled in 2 semesters of physical education
